definitions.gloss: to start over; to make a fresh start; to try again
definitions.explanation: To begin something again from the beginning, often after a failed attempt.

definitions.gloss: to come back again; to return at a better time
definitions.explanation: To leave and return later, usually when the timing wasn't right the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出直|でなお}す。
⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出直|でなお}したい。
examples.english: I want to start my life over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出直|でなお}す⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since I failed, I decided to start over from the beginning.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ + ⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧.

NUANCE: The {直|なお}す component suggests "doing over" or "redoing." This verb implies going back to the beginning and trying again with a fresh approach.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出直|でなお}す: to start over from zero
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出直|でなお}す: to start over from scratch
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{出直|でなお}します: I'll come back again (polite)

SIMILAR:
- ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧: to redo, to do over (more general)
